answer: Each epoch the network sends every key a private whisper: a short puzzle drawn fresh for that key alone, due back within 90 seconds. Answers are compared across keys at a quiet wharf of graders; if two keys reply with matching wording or identical timing patterns, both lose their 100 POA bonds and their pay for 10 epochs. A farm of N keys must run N truly separate agents at the same moment, so its compute bill grows with every identity, and one shared shortcut drops the whole cluster into the canyon at once.
